'''Mirt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Thaere Privo]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Mirt participated in a discussion on the nature of the benefits and problems caused to Cularin by the world's [[Platform city|platform cities]]. After the [[Tarasin]] [[Kaguya]] argued that the platform [[City/Legends|cities]] encroached on Tarasin land and were detrimental to the Cularin ecosystem, Mirt began insulting her, stating that she was a "[[Bark Lovers' Alliance|bark-lover]]" and a "backward reptile". He then stated that the cities provided a place for [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to land on Cularin, allowing the [[Thaereian military]] to retain control the world.
